questions.q: What were the Doctor and the animals doing when Too-Too heard a noise outside?
choices: Eating their supper together at the long kitchen table by the window
Sitting round the fire while the Doctor read aloud to them
Selling radishes and roses at the stall by the gate
Clearing the deep snow away from the front door
questions.evidence: the Doctor was reading aloud to them

questions.q: What was the message that Chee-Chee's cousin sent from Africa?
choices: The King of Africa wanted the Doctor to come and be his own royal doctor
A sickness was killing the monkeys, and they begged him to come
The crocodile's family wanted him to come home to Africa at once
The swallows needed the Doctor to mend a broken wing
questions.evidence: There is a terrible sickness among the monkeys out there.

questions.q: Who carried the message all the way from Africa?
choices: A stork
A crow
A swallow
A gull

questions.q: Why did the Doctor say the swallow "must be perished with the cold"?
choices: She had flown through a snowstorm with a broken wing
The swallows had flown South weeks ago, so she was out in the bitter winter
She had been waiting outside on the rain-butt all night long in the snow and wind
Swallows always catch colds when they fly across the sea
questions.evidence: The swallows flew South six weeks ago!

questions.q: What had happened to the last twopence in the money-box?
choices: Gub-Gub had spent it on apples from the grocer
Sarah had taken it with her when she left the house
The Doctor had spent it on a rattle for a badger's baby
Too-Too had used it to pay the fishmonger's bill for the week's fish
questions.evidence: you spent it on a rattle for that badger's baby when he was teething

questions.q: How did the Doctor get a boat to take them to Africa?
choices: He borrowed it from a sailor whose baby he had cured of measles
He bought it from a fisherman using the money the animals had saved up
The Cat's-meat-Man lent him his brother's fishing boat
The swallow led them to an old boat left on the beach
questions.evidence: I knew a seaman once who brought his baby to me with measles

questions.q: Polynesia says to bring a bell "to tell the time by." What does she mean?
choices: The bell rings by itself to wake everyone in the morning
Ringing it every half-hour lets you know what time it is
The bell tells other ships that it is time to move out of the way
The bell warns the sailors when a storm is about to come
questions.evidence: You go and ring it every half-hour and then you know what time it is.

questions.q: What did the animals do with the house key before they left?
choices: Hid it under a stone seat in the garden
Gave it to the Cat's-meat-Man to keep until they came home
Gave it to the old horse who lived in the stable
Sent it to Sarah with a letter
questions.evidence: gave the key to the old horse who lived in the stable

questions.q: Why did Gub-Gub say the bed on the ship was not a bed?
choices: It was much too small for a pig to fit in
It looked like a shelf
It was a pile of old sails and rope
It was made of hard wooden boards

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: How the Doctor spent a cold winter at home
How a call for help from Africa led the Doctor to set sail there
How Polynesia taught the animals everything about life on a ship
How the Doctor finally solved his money troubles in Puddleby
questions.evidence: beg you to come to Africa to stop the sickness
